metadata.notes: Direct USB ALSA retest resolved the transport mapping: B9 57 03 arms all channels in overdub/overburn mode; BA 57 03 starts playback; BB 57 03 stops transport. Any previous interpretation of B9 as REC was incorrect and has been superseded. Scene SAVE is confirmed: B9 56 03 saves the currently selected scene over USB ALSA.

commands.name: OVERDUB_ALL_ARM
commands.description: Arms all channels in the mixer overdub/overburn mode, per direct hardware test. User described this as 'OVERBURN ALL CANAL'.

commands.name: STOP
commands.description: Stops playback/transport. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: PLAY
commands.description: Starts playback ('PLAY SOUND'). Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.

commands.name: FF
commands.description: Fast-forward command verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: REW
commands.description: Rewind command verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_MODE
commands.description: Enters/activates scene operation mode: SAVE / RECALL / DELETE indicators blink. Verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_RECALL
commands.description: Triggers RECALL for the currently selected scene. Verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_7
commands.description: Selects scene 7; leaves scene operation pending until RECALL.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_6
commands.description: Selects scene 6; leaves scene operation pending until RECALL.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_8
commands.description: Selects scene 8; leaves scene operation pending until RECALL.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_9
commands.description: Selects scene 9; leaves scene operation pending until RECALL.

commands.name: RESET
commands.description: Observed to trigger RESET on hardware; exact reset scope/effect should be characterized before automated use.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_1
commands.description: Selects scene 1; leaves scene operation pending until RECALL.

commands.name: OVERDUB
commands.description: Observed hardware action labeled by user as OVERBURN/overdub-like mode; exact semantics/name still to verify.

commands.name: SCENE_SAVE
commands.description: Saves the currently selected scene. Verified by direct USB ALSA hardware test.
